description: Where amounts are announced or listed, giving stops being voluntary and becomes a published statement about the household.

aspect: Prosperity framing makes refusal a lack of faith
description: Where giving is linked to blessing, not giving is recast as insufficient belief rather than insufficient money.
The pledge sheets go round the row. Her neighbour writes £500. The sheet is collected by the man who will read them out on Sunday. She writes £200 and does not eat out in January.
energy_note: Two hundred pounds and a thin January.
